14. Foundations of Competitive Equilibrium

Why is the price mechanism justified — the cooperative foundations of competitive equilibrium, via the shrinking core and blocking coalitions.

  • Shrinking of the Core (Debreu–Scarf) — Replicating the economy creates new coalitions that slice the core down. Watch the core interval shrink to the single competitive point across N=1,2,4,8N = 1, 2, 4, 8N=1,2,4,8 replicas — in a large economy, core and competitive equilibrium coincide.
  • Blocking Coalitions — Move the allocation with the sliders. Violate individual rationality and {1}\{1\}{1} or {2}\{2\}{2} blocks alone; be Pareto inefficient and the grand coalition blocks via the lens region. The allocations that survive are exactly the core.
